title: Star-nosed mole ka ajab sach
idea: The star-nosed mole has a unique snout with 22 tentacles and 25,000 sensory receptors, enabling it to eat prey in as little as 120 milliseconds.

lines.text: Iss strange janwar ke naak pe hain 22 ajeeb tentacles!
Iske snout par hote hain 25,000 se zyada sensitive receptors!
Ye receptors isko andhere mein khana dhundne mein madad karte hain.
Iska dimaag sirf 8 milliseconds mein decide karta hai ki khana khana hai ya nahi!
Ye duniya ka sabse fast khane wala mammal hai jo 120 milliseconds mein shikaar kha leta hai.
Kya aapne pehle kabhi is anokhe star-nosed mole ke baare mein suna tha?

youtube.title: Iss Ajab Jaanwar Ka Sach Uda Degi Aapke Hosh! 🤯 #shorts
youtube.description:
Star-nosed mole ke paas hote hain 22 pink tentacles aur 25,000 sensory receptors, jo isko banate hain duniya ka sabse fast forager!

#shorts #facts #animals #amazing #wildlife

facts.claim: The star-nosed mole has 25,000 sensory receptors on 22 appendages.
The nose has 22 appendages and is about 1.5 cm in diameter.
It takes as little as 120 milliseconds to identify and consume food.
Its brain decides in approximately eight milliseconds if prey is edible.
